# `Q-2-17` — Unclosed Subscript

> A `~subscript~` run opens with `~` but no closing `~` appears
> before the end of the block.

## What this means

Tilde-delimited subscript (`~text~`) must be balanced inside the
same block. This error fires when an opening `~` appears without
a matching close.

## Why this happens

A typo, or a literal `~` (a home-directory shorthand, for
instance) read as a subscript opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `~`. For literal tildes in prose, escape:

```markdown
The home directory \~/work/.
```

## Example

```markdown
~
```
